rapport_notes: Warm, professional tone; good pacing and clear explanations; minor opening confusion doesn't derail the overall friendly presence.
process_discipline_notes: Rep asked 'does all that make sense so far?' but didn't hold silence—customer acknowledged immediately, so the pause was present but minimal/not truly held.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Well, yes, so this was in regards, thank you so much for calling back your move on September 13th. I just needed to confirm a couple of details and just make sure that we have everything so that we can get you an accurate estimate. Did you have some time?
evidence_quotes.agenda: Well, yes, so before I kinda dive in to deep what are the most important questions that I can answer for you, of course, pricing, cause that's important but anything outside of that?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer said 'No' to the agenda question and rep immediately pivoted to logistics (storage, big items, stairs) without probing any concerns or objections.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: I do have an hourly rate of $210 that does include the two movers, of course, the truck. And then what that also includes it's gonna be, I know where damage coverage that does cover-up. To $2,000 for any kind of incidental...
evidence_quotes.sheet2_whos_coming: ...it also includes our meet the mover feature, which you were able to get some insight on the actual movers that are going to be helping you that day. We don't work with daily contract workers, they are professionally trained in that it.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: Now if for whatever reason we don't arrive within the time window that we agree upon then, money is automatically deducted off of your final bill...
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: I do have you at the two and a half to three and a half hours given the information that you gave to me. And so, actually cost wise I'm estimating a cost of range between $525 and 735.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass_window: And that's just an estimate of course obviously if everything is kind of ready to go when we get there, I really would see this I mean, going you know, well over our minimum which is the two and a half.
evidence_quotes.close: Rep asked 'did you want to go ahead and get that truck reserved' but customer asked for email instead; rep transitioned to email confirmation without an explicit rate-lock statement or final ask to confirm commitment.

top_strength: Excellent quid pro quo framing upfront ('get an accurate estimate') and seamless delivery of three key differentiators (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time Guarantee) as part of the rate/service explanation—all three landed clearly and professionally.
coaching_note: The agenda question was asked after logistics probing had already begun (customer told you about the storage unit and big items first), and when the customer said 'No' to concerns, the rep didn't probe deeper—two critical discovery gaps that left potential objections unaddressed; also missing communication/day-before call, and no explicit rate-lock or close ask when the customer asked for email instead.
